title: Control 22 / DP 1956/2026 and Control 24 interconnection register

scope.purpose: Preserve separate procedural identities while exposing typed evidential connections among the private-actor, insolvency-administrator and judicial-supervision layers of Insolvency Proceeding 36/2012.
scope.public_source_policy: Public-safe summaries and status metadata only. Native pleadings, signatures, contact details, addresses, private correspondence, credentials and restricted material remain outside public Git.
does_not_do: It does not transfer allegations, knowledge, intent, causation, guilt or liability from one person or proceeding to another.
It does not treat a complaint as proof of its own allegations.
It does not treat a filing locator as a court case number.
It does not state that a formal querella has been filed without a filing receipt.

edges.does_not_mean: Control 22 is not itself the court proceeding number.
Every act in the insolvency proceeding is attributed to the insolvency administrator or is criminal.
The role page adjudicates the complaint.
An insolvency appeal determines criminal liability or vice versa.
The supplement is not an autonomous complaint or new case.
Control 24 is not itself a querella and does not prove a querella was filed.
An adverse or omitted ruling alone proves judicial misconduct.
The result in DIP 2/2026 determines the status or merits of Control 24.
A CGPJ action proves or excludes criminal liability.
Knowledge, conduct, intent or liability propagates from private actors to the administrator.
Administrator conduct is automatically judicial conduct, or judicial approval absorbs the administrator's own duties and accounting.
A beneficial effect for a private actor proves judicial intent, coordination or guilt.

priority_gaps.description: Obtain the primary bridge showing how Control 22 was allocated or associated with DP 1956/2026.
Confirm whether any reform or appeal was filed against the provisional dismissal; drafts are not filing proof.
Obtain Dean's Office and/or High Court certification of Control 24 entry, outgoing route, recipient organ, current location and result.
Obtain the electronic registry metadata and joinder record for the 25 June supplement.
Locate any filing receipt for a formal querella before representing that such a querella was filed.
Produce the certified insolvency docket and actor-specific document-to-knowledge-to-response matrix for the funded exit, €400,000, credit figures, 2021 bidding, 2022 adjudication and final accounts.

representation_rules: Control 22 is not DP 1956/2026, though later sources associate them.
Control 24 is not a NIG, preliminary-proceedings number or formal querella.
A supplement does not create an autonomous complaint unless a primary source proves that status.
Prepared, reviewed or sent to counsel does not equal filed.
Presented does not equal admitted; admitted does not equal proven; archived does not equal a general merits adjudication.
Related does not equal consolidated; shared evidence does not equal shared responsibility.
The absence of a document from the finite repository is an open production question, not proof of non-existence.
